title_en: Marko Kralj settles the wedding fee
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Epic song about Marko Kraljevic. Several lines are my reading: 'шчо/што' in the girl's speech, 'кај му се кули' as 'where are his towers', 'минци/минцови' as coins, 'тога стегна' as 'tightened up/tightened the horse', and the final line 'заплатила десница' as 'has paid'. The original text contains a few garbled dialect forms.

lines.en: One morning Marko set out early
from Prilep, Marko from the Varosh,
to stroll the Kosovo district.
The first roosters had not yet crowed,

lines.cyr: тој се фрли Шарцу на рамена
lines.lat: toj se frli Šarcu na ramena
lines.en: he threw himself onto Sharets's back

lines.cyr: и ми тргна по бели друмови,
lines.lat: i mi trgna po beli drumovi,
lines.en: and set off along the white roads,

lines.cyr: по среде ноќ низ Скопје помина,
lines.lat: po srede noḱ niz Skopje pomina,
lines.en: at midnight he passed through Skopje,
when the first roosters crowed,
he passed the Kacanik gorges,
when the dawn was breaking in the morning,
he reached the Kosovo district,
when the morning sun was about to rise,

lines.cyr: тој ми влезе во Косовско поле.
lines.lat: toj mi vleze vo Kosovsko pole.
lines.en: he entered the Kosovo plain.

lines.cyr: Ништо Марко среќа не го срети,
lines.lat: Ništo Marko sreḱa ne go sreti,
lines.en: No luck at all met Marko,
he only met a Kosovo girl.
Marko says to her: - Good morning,
good morning, Kosovo widow.
And she answered him:

lines.cyr: – Јас не сум ти Косовска вдовица,
lines.lat: – Jas ne sum ti Kosovska vdovica,
lines.en: - I am not a Kosovo widow to you,
I am a Kosovo girl.
Then Marko Kralj said:
- Hey you, Kosovo girl,

lines.cyr: ќе те прашам, право да ми кажеш:
lines.lat: ḱe te prašam, pravo da mi kažeš:
lines.en: I will ask you, tell me truly:
why has your hair turned white,
why is your white face ruined?
Or do you grieve for your family?

lines.cyr: Што не си се млада омажила?
lines.lat: Što ne si se mlada omažila?
lines.en: Why have you not married while young?
Then the Kosovo girl said:

lines.cyr: – Ја не жалам од рода моего,
lines.lat: – Ja ne žalam od roda moego,
lines.en: - I do not grieve for my family,
but it is thirty years now
that a black Arab came to me,
he bought the wedding fee from the emperor:

lines.cyr: кој ќе јунак млади се ожени,
lines.lat: koj ḱe junak mladi se oženi,
lines.en: any young hero who marries

lines.cyr: нему сака триесет и три минца,
lines.lat: nemu saka trieset i tri minca,
lines.en: he wants thirty-three coins from him,

lines.cyr: а девојка која ќе се мажи,
lines.lat: a devojka koja ḱe se maži,
lines.en: and a girl who is to marry,
from her he wants thirty coins.
My brothers are poor,

lines.cyr: ми немаат азно да му дадат,
lines.lat: mi nemaat azno da mu dadat,
lines.en: they have no treasure to give him,
that is why my hair turned white,
my white face is ruined!
Then Marko reaches into his bosom,
he took out thirty coins,
and gave them to the Kosovo girl.
Then Marko Kraljevic said:

lines.cyr: – Да си сакаш момче спроти тебе,
lines.lat: – Da si sakaš momče sproti tebe,
lines.en: - Pick a lad for yourself,

lines.cyr: да си сакаш, да си се омажиш
lines.lat: da si sakaš, da si se omažiš
lines.en: pick one and marry him

lines.cyr: и на Арап свадбина да платиш.
lines.lat: i na Arap svadbina da platiš.
lines.en: and pay the Arab the wedding fee.
I will ask you, Kosovo girl,

lines.cyr: ќе те прашам, право да ми кажеш,
lines.lat: ḱe te prašam, pravo da mi kažeš,
lines.en: I will ask you, tell me truly,
by your family and your blood,
by our Orthodox faith,
by the name of Jesus Christ,

lines.cyr: немој мене ти да ме излажеш:
lines.lat: nemoj mene ti da me izlažeš:
lines.en: do not lie to me:
Where are the Arab's towers?
The Kosovo girl answered:
- His towers are easy to recognize,
below Kosovo, in the green meadows.
There is a white tent there,
on the tent a golden apple,
it shines like the bright sun,
you can recognize it from afar.
Then Marko Kraljevic tightened up,
then he tightened his swift horse.
The Arab's guard spotted him,
spotted him even from afar,
he says to the black Arab:
- Arab, our lord,
a fearsome hero comes along the road,
and his horse is terribly enraged,

lines.cyr: од нозе му оган искри летат,
lines.lat: od noze mu ogan iskri letat,
lines.en: sparks of fire fly from his legs,

lines.cyr: од уста ми бели пени паѓат,
lines.lat: od usta mi beli peni paǵat,
lines.en: white foam falls from his mouth,

lines.cyr: од носот му сини пламни бијат,
lines.lat: od nosot mu sini plamni bijat,
lines.en: blue flames beat from his nose,
lightning flashes from his eyes
and most fearsome of all, he has changed:

lines.cyr: на плеќи му кожув од мечиште,
lines.lat: na pleḱi mu kožuv od mečište,
lines.en: on his back a bearskin coat,

lines.cyr: на глава му калпак од волчиште
lines.lat: na glava mu kalpak od volčište
lines.en: on his head a wolfskin cap

lines.cyr: и во уста нешто црно носи
lines.lat: i vo usta nešto crno nosi
lines.en: and in his mouth he carries something black
like a half-year-old lamb.
Then the black Arab said:
- Hey you guards, over here,
receive him well
and take the weapon from his belt,

lines.cyr: пратите го при мене да дојде.
lines.lat: pratite go pri mene da dojde.
lines.en: send him to come to me.
That is a young unmarried man,
he is coming to pay the wedding fee,
he will give me countless treasure.
The Arab had not yet finished speaking,
when Marko Kralj drew near.
When Marko came near the guards,
the guards all fled,

lines.cyr: кој по поле, кој по планина.
lines.lat: koj po pole, koj po planina.
lines.en: some over the field, some into the mountain.
Marko heads straight to the Arab's tent,
Marko says to him: - Good morning,
good morning, our lord,
lord, Arab from across the sea.
Tell me what the wedding fee is,
that I may pay you the imperial wedding fee,

lines.cyr: оти после патов ќе си гледам,
lines.lat: oti posle patov ḱe si gledam,
lines.en: for afterwards I will look to my road,

lines.cyr: зар сватови на пат ме чекаат.
lines.lat: zar svatovi na pat me čekaat.
lines.en: wedding guests are waiting for me on the way.
Then the black Arab said:
- Hey you, unknown hero,

lines.cyr: дали уште не си се научил?
lines.lat: dali ušte ne si se naučil?
lines.en: have you not yet learned?
It is now thirty years
that I have sat on the flat Kosovo:

lines.cyr: кој ќе јунак млади се ожени,
lines.lat: koj ḱe junak mladi se oženi,
lines.en: any young hero who marries,

lines.cyr: нему зимам триесет и три минца,
lines.lat: nemu zimam trieset i tri minca,
lines.en: I take thirty-three coins from him,

lines.cyr: а девојка која ќе се мажи,
lines.lat: a devojka koja ḱe se maži,
lines.en: and a girl who is to marry,
I take thirty coins from her,
for a great hero like you,

lines.cyr: и шеесет пак не ти се многу.
lines.lat: i šeeset pak ne ti se mnogu.
lines.en: even sixty is not too much.
Then Marko reaches into his bosom,
he took out only three coins;
- Take, our lord,

lines.cyr: на ти тебе, саде три минцови,
lines.lat: na ti tebe, sade tri mincovi,
lines.en: take, only three coins,
believe me, I have no other treasure.

lines.cyr: Ко ќе појдам по убава невеста,
lines.lat: Ko ḱe pojdam po ubava nevesta,
lines.en: When I go for a beautiful bride,

lines.cyr: што ќе мене дарој ме дарува,
lines.lat: što ḱe mene daroj me daruva,
lines.en: whatever gift she gives me,
I will give you that gift.
Then the black Arab said:

lines.cyr: - Ал ме лажиш, ал вистина велиш,
lines.lat: - Al me lažiš, al vistina veliš,
lines.en: - Are you lying to me, or telling the truth,

lines.cyr: ал со мене шега ќе си биеш?
lines.lat: al so mene šega ḱe si bieš?
lines.en: or are you making a joke with me?
And he took a heavy mace,
he struck him three or four times.
Then Marko Kralj said:
- May God kill you, black Arab!

lines.cyr: Ал се смееш, ал вистина маваш,
lines.lat: Al se smeeš, al vistina mavaš,
lines.en: Are you laughing, or really swinging,

lines.cyr: ал од кожув правот ми го тресеш?
lines.lat: al od kožuv pravot mi go treseš?
lines.en: or shaking the dust from my fur coat?

lines.cyr: Почекај ме и јас да те удрам,
lines.lat: Počekaj me i jas da te udram,
lines.en: Wait for me, so I may strike you too,

lines.cyr: ти ќе видиш јунак како мава.
lines.lat: ti ḱe vidiš junak kako mava.
lines.en: you will see how a hero swings.
Again Marko Kralj drew,
he drew out his mace.
When Marko swung at the Arab,
thank God, a great wonder!
His body fell into the earth,

lines.cyr: а глава му на страна побегна.
lines.lat: a glava mu na strana pobegna.
lines.en: and his head fled to one side.

lines.cyr: Пак се пушти по триесет стражари,
lines.lat: Pak se pušti po trieset stražari,
lines.en: Again he rushed at the thirty guards,
twenty-seven he beat down, all of them,
and only three he left,

lines.cyr: да ми личат три млади телали,
lines.lat: da mi ličat tri mladi telali,
lines.en: to serve as three young heralds,

lines.cyr: да ми личат низ рамно Косово:
lines.lat: da mi ličat niz ramno Kosovo:
lines.en: to serve across the flat Kosovo:
- Where there is a hero to marry,

lines.cyr: да си сака мома спроти него,
lines.lat: da si saka moma sproti nego,
lines.en: let him pick a girl for himself,

lines.cyr: да си сака - да си се ожени!
lines.lat: da si saka - da si se oženi!
lines.en: let him pick, and marry!
Where there is a girl to marry,

lines.cyr: да си сака момче спроти неа,
lines.lat: da si saka momče sproti nea,
lines.en: let her pick a lad for herself,

lines.cyr: да си сака да си се омажи!
lines.lat: da si saka da si se omaži!
lines.en: let her pick, and marry!
Marko's right hand has paid,
it has paid the whole wedding fee.
